messages:
carl_prod: dropped a new compact landing mock — https://www.figma.com/file/new/usage-compact-2026 (frame 'Compact landing v2'). main question: keep org banner sticky or let project grid float?

zoe_design: sticky org banner helps finance users. project grid below as a compact rail (top 6 by spend) keeps devs happy. trying a hybrid: banner sticky, small project rail collapsed by default.

mike_eng: hybrid is fine. backend will return top_projects and a recommended_scope flag. prefer not to lazy-load all projects on first paint for large orgs.

jas_billing: ops reminder: invoices are org-scoped. project links should never read like "Download invoice" standalone. copy idea: header CTA -> "Download org invoice (PDF)" and project action -> "View org invoice for this project".

lena_a11y: quick accessibility notes: 1) sticky banner must not trap keyboard focus. 2) any expand/collapse must use aria-expanded and provide SR text. 3) sparklines must be accompanied by SR-only data tables. contrast on the status pill needs bumping.

zoe_design: thanks — will update pill contrast and add SR tables. thinking of a micro-toggle in the project preview: 'Tokens: % / absolute'. small segmented control, aria-live updates.

mike_eng: implement toggle client-side, but server should return both absolute and percent values to avoid re-compute. also, for token-detail expansion use paginated endpoint and cache results in-session.

jas_billing: CSV export is heavy. make it an async job behind a modal, show ETA and row estimate after request. RBAC: only billing-admin can export CSV; others see 'Request export' which files a ticket.

lena_a11y: modal checklist: trap focus, Esc to close, clear heading, aria-describedby for export warnings, ensure download link is a real anchor so screen readers announce file type.

carl_prod: timeline: Zoe update mocks + contrast (today), Mike spec pagination & caching (PR next week), Jas finalize RBAC wording, Lena do a11y smoke after update. design-review Friday 13:00 UTC.

calendar-bot: Reminder: design-review slot confirmed Friday 13:00 UTC. :spiral_calendar_pad:

zoe_design: short UX nit — keep landing under ~3 vertical scrolls on 1440w. collapsing rail by default helps. I'll post updated figma after changes.

mike_eng: small perf ask: for orgs with >200 projects, only render top 6 and add 'See all projects' link to full paged grid. server can return top_projects array.

jas_billing: copy tweak: change 'Est charges' -> 'Estimated charges (pre-tax)'. legal prefers explicit language.

lena_a11y: also run a color-blindness check (deutan/protan) after color tweaks, and avoid color-only indicators on badges.

carl_prod: great. if no objections i'll lock the mock after Zoe's update and schedule dev spike. closing this thread unless blockers appear.
